Storozhynets Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivetska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'fenced and protected,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'yes.' In 1937, the fascist Iron Guard movement attacked Storozhynets's Jews during Romania's short-lived, explicitly antisemitic Goga-Cuza government. During the spring 1941 Soviet occupation, hundreds of Jewish families were exiled to Siberia and their property confiscated; under the subsequent Romanian-German occupation, 300 Jews fled to Cernauti (Chernivtsi), and the remnants of the community were deported to Transnistria. About 10 percent of Storozhynets's Jews survived the war.
